questions.stem_latex:
Peter borrows \$480 000 from a bank. The loan is to be repaid over 20 years in equal monthly instalments of \$$M$ at the end of each month, after the interest has been added. Reducible interest is charged at 4.8% p.a., calculated monthly.

Let \$$A_n$ be the amount owing at the end of $n$ months after the repayment has been made.

parts.label: a
parts.latex:
Show that the expression of the amount owing at the end of second month, $A_2$, after the repayment has been made is:

$$A_2 = 480000 \times 1.004^2 - 1.004M - M$$

parts.label: b
parts.latex: Show that $A_n = 480000 \times 1.004^n - M\left(\dfrac{1.004^n - 1}{0.004}\right)$.

parts.label: c
parts.latex: Hence find the value of $M$.

solutions.latex:
Max. speed $= 3$ m/s (amplitude of $\dot{x}$)

Speed $= |\dot{x}|$, so $\pm 3 = 3\sin\left(t - \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)$, i.e. $\ddot{x} = 3\cos\left(t - \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = 0$

$\cos\left(t - \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = 0$

$t - \dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{\pi}{2}$ or $\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$

$t = \dfrac{5\pi}{6}$ or $\dfrac{11\pi}{6}$
solutions.marks_breakdown: 3: correct solutions for speed and times; 2: correct speed and one correct time; 1: correct speed OR one correct time

solutions.latex:
$x = \int v\,dt = \int \dot{x}\,dt$

$x = \int 3\sin\left(t - \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) dt$

$x = -3\cos\left(t - \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) + C$

At $t = 0$, $x = -3$ (to the left):

$-3 = -3\cos\left(0 - \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) + C$

$C = -1.5$

$\therefore x = -3\cos\left(t - \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) - 1.5$
solutions.marks_breakdown: 2: correct solution; 1: correct integration; 1: finding the constant correctly from incorrect integration
